ocucor.name: Ocucor
ocucor.description: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.

onos.name: Onos
onos.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
